links.outcome: Accuracy/completeness of LLM cleft lip and palate answers; outdated or incomplete clinical knowledge
links.effect: Median GQS 4.33 (GPT-4o) vs 5.00 (Gemini) in consensus domains, not significantly different (p=0.691); common errors included overgeneralized outcomes, outdated surgical timing, omitted multidisciplinary team roles.
links.quote: The most common inaccuracies were overgeneralization of outcomes, outdated surgical timing, and omission of multidisciplinary team roles.

unlisted_practices: Reliability-first filter (inter-rater agreement threshold, Fleiss kappa ≥0.60) before comparing LLM quality

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and quality of patient-facing cleft lip and palate information generated by LLMs (GPT-4o and Gemini 2.5 Pro) using expert clinician ratings, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
